sampling_design.exclude: all prior 100 body solves: legacy60 + P11 fresh40
sampling_design.dominant_reconstructor_definition: raw reconstructor frequency >=200 in frozen 10,591 population
sampling_design.within_cell_selection: coarse-era round-robin followed by deterministic SHA-256 rank
sampling_design.replacement_policy: no outcome-triggered replacement; retrieval failures remain failures unless a separately presealed replacement amendment is committed before geometry is observed
sampling_design.batch_assignment: 8 batches × 10; rotating cell quota schedule [3,3,2,2] across the four cells so each cell totals 20 while acquisition batch is not cell-pure; deterministic within-cell era-round-robin order

fixed_analysis.structural_match: R1 hard caliper on exact 2x2 action-opportunity TV distance <=1 action-mass unit

method_sign_divergence.rule: CFOP mean < 0 AND NONCFOP mean > 0 AND (NONCFOP mean - CFOP mean) >= 1/18

q5_composition_cancellation.rule: abs(pooled Q5 mean) <= 0.5 * mean(abs(CFOP Q5 mean), abs(NONCFOP Q5 mean))

progress_fragility.rule: among Q4,Q6,Q10 pooled means, at least two differ from pooled Q5 mean by >= 1/36 in absolute value

terminal_adjudication.partial_replication: exactly one or two primary predictions pass
terminal_adjudication.support_limited: any primary prediction cannot be evaluated because its frozen support floor is not met

secondary_readouts: fresh80 vs P11 fresh40 effect-direction comparison after fresh-only verdict
forbidden: change selected IDs after observing body geometry
change R1 caliper or progress partitions
pool prior100 before fresh-only terminal verdict
use secondary readouts to redefine primary success
